summary: Weekly significance recomputation over the 627 counted recommendations. Per-rater scores were stored on 80 more records (57 copied from the original rater file, 23 scored by two fresh blind AI raters, none needing a third rater), so 586 records now carry them and 41 still lack them. Weighted share in effect 18.0 percent (unweighted 18.2), weighted progress 30.2 (unweighted 30.1), centered band 17.8 to 18.2 on 586 records, rater agreement (quadratic-weighted kappa) reach 0.82, magnitude 0.86, breadth 0.85, fiscal 0.89, composite 0.91 on 586 records; stored scores and weights unchanged.
title: Significance recomputation: rater scores backfilled on 80 records, weighted share 18.0 percent
